context_requirements: A defined molecular target for the drug class is required; none is listed in the Drug Repurposing Hub annotation.
The nine cell lines are adherent solid-tumor or immortalized lines, not primary lymphocytes or lymphocyte-derived lines.
A lymphocyte-specific mechanism would require expression of the relevant lymphocyte target or signaling pathway, which is not established for these lines.
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines.
Shared transcriptional signatures across multiple lines that match known lymphocyte inhibition pathways.
Evidence that one or more of these lines expresses the presumed lymphocyte target and responds accordingly.
